scale_colour_group <- function(...) {
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Intervention" = ggsci::pal_lancet(palette = "lanonc", alpha = 1)(2)[2],
      "Placebo" = ggsci::pal_lancet(palette = "lanonc", alpha = 1)(2)[1]
    ),
    breaks = c("Intervention", "Placebo")
  )
}

scale_color_group <- function(...) {
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Intervention" = ggsci::pal_lancet(palette = "lanonc", alpha = 1)(2)[2],
      "Placebo" = ggsci::pal_lancet(palette = "lanonc", alpha = 1)(2)[1]
    ),
    breaks = c("Intervention", "Placebo")
  )
}

scale_fill_group <- function(...) {

      "Placebo" = ggsci::pal_lancet(palette = "lanonc", alpha = 1)(2)[1]
    ),
    breaks = c("Intervention", "Placebo")
  )
}

add_gg_theme <- function(plt) {
  
  # Gemeinsame override.aes Definition
  legend_override <- list(
    shape = 22,
    size = 5,
    linetype = 0,
    linewidth = 0,
    alpha = 0.8,
    colour = "black"
  )
  
  plt <- plt +
    scale_fill_group() +
    scale_colour_group() +
    scale_color_group() +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() + 
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    ) +
    guides(
      color     = guide_legend(title = "Treatment", order = 1, override.aes = legend_override),
      colour    = guide_legend(title = "Treatment", order = 1, override.aes = legend_override),
      fill      = guide_legend(title = "Treatment", order = 1, override.aes = legend_override),
      shape     = guide_legend(title = "Treatment", order = 1, override.aes = legend_override),
      linetype  = guide_legend(title = "Treatment", order = 1, override.aes = legend_override),
      size      = guide_legend(title = "Treatment", order = 1, override.aes = legend_override),
      alpha     = guide_legend(title = "Treatment", order = 1, override.aes = legend_override),
      linewidth = guide_legend(title = "Treatment", order = 1, override.aes = legend_override)
    )

  return(plt)
}


create_diagnostic_plots_one <- function(fit) {

    res <- resid(fit)
    fitted_vals <- fitted(fit)

    p_qq <- ggplot(data = data.frame(res = res), mapping = aes(sample = res)) +
    stat_qq() +
    stat_qq_line(color = "#04488c") +
    labs(
        x = "Theoretical Quantiles", 
        y = "Sample Quantiles",
        title = "Q-Q Plot"
    )   

    p_qq <- add_gg_theme(p_qq)

    p_resid <- ggplot(
        data.frame(fitted = fitted_vals, res = res),
        aes(x = fitted, y = res)
        ) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#04488c") +
        labs(x = "Predicted Values", y = "Residuals", title = "Residual Plot")

    p_resid <- add_gg_theme(p_resid)

    plt <- p_qq + p_resid

    return(plt)
}

create_diagnostic_plots_two <- function(fit1, fit2) {

    res1 <- resid(fit1)
    fitted_vals1 <- fitted(fit1)

    p_qq1 <- ggplot(data = data.frame(res = res1), mapping = aes(sample = res1)) +
    stat_qq() +
    stat_qq_line(color = "#04488c") +
    labs(
        x = "Theoretical Quantiles", 
        y = "Sample Quantiles",
        title = "Q-Q Plot"
    )   

    p_qq1 <- add_gg_theme(p_qq1)

    p_resid1 <- ggplot(
        data.frame(fitted = fitted_vals1, res = res1),
        aes(x = fitted, y = res)
        ) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#04488c") +
        labs(x = "Predicted Values", y = "Residuals", title = "Residual Plot")

    p_resid1 <- add_gg_theme(p_resid1)

    res2 <- resid(fit2)
    fitted_vals2 <- fitted(fit2)

    p_qq2 <- ggplot(data = data.frame(res = res2), mapping = aes(sample = res2)) +
    stat_qq() +
    stat_qq_line(color = "#04488c") +
    labs(
        x = "Theoretical Quantiles", 
        y = "Sample Quantiles",
        title = "Q-Q Plot"
    )   

    p_qq2 <- add_gg_theme(p_qq2)

    p_resid2 <- ggplot(
        data.frame(fitted = fitted_vals2, res = res2),
        aes(x = fitted, y = res2)
        ) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#04488c") +
        labs(
            x = "Predicted Values", 
            y = "Residuals",
            title = "Residual Plot"
        )

    p_resid2 <- add_gg_theme(p_resid2)


    plt <- (p_qq1 / p_resid1) | (p_qq2 / p_resid2)

    return(plt)
}

get_kable_table <- function(tbl, abbreviations) {
  tbl <- tbl %>%
    as_kable_extra(
      booktabs = TRUE,
      longtable = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      font_size = 8,
      latex_options = c("repeat_header", "scale_down", "hold_position"),
    ) %>%
    footnote(
        general = abbreviations,
        threeparttable = T,
        general_title = "Abbreviations: "
    )

    # kable-Objekt ist intern ein character-String
    attr_backup <- attributes(tbl)
    tbl <- gsub("p_adj", "$p_{adj}$", tbl, fixed = TRUE)
    attributes(tbl) <- attr_backup
  
  return(tbl)
}
